response.overview: Hardly anyone remains untouched by the topic of cancer – whether through their own diagnosis or through a loved one. CANCER SOUL  opens a new perspective on cancer. Courageous. Holistic. And never told like this before. The film views cancer not only as a medical diagnosis, but as a complex interplay of body, mind and soul. Renowned cancer experts, doctors, alternative practitioners, energy healers and former patients speak openly about questions that concern many people:  Why does cancer develop?  What role do emotions, lifestyle, and environment play?  What treatment and support options are available – both conventional and holistic?  What can give people hope in these times?  CANCER SOUL combines modern medicine with new perspectives from naturopathy, psycho-oncology, biomedicine and spiritual approaches.  A film that doesn't pretend to have all the answers – but opens up new ways of thinking.
response.title: Cancer-Soul
